The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the concept of search engines using the provided analogy: Imagine the Internet is a massive, chaotic library with billions of books (websites) and pages (web pages). Without a system to organize them, finding specific information would be like trying to locate a single sentence in a library with no catalog or index. A search engine acts as that essential library index. Just as a librarian or a card catalog helps you pinpoint the exact book and page you need, a search engine like Google scans the entire "library" of the Internet and directs you to the specific website and page that contains the answer you are looking for.
